title: Contrapunctus VIII

captions.text: ☞ Subject I alone, in the alto.
☞ The answer in the bass, on A.
☞ Subject I in the soprano: all three voices are in.
☞ Stretto: subject I in the alto, then in the bass two beats later.
☞ Subject II in the alto, falling in repeated notes, under subject I.
☞ Subject II in the soprano, on E♭.
☞ Subject II in the bass, under subject I in the alto.
☞ Subject III in the alto: the work's main subject, inverted, with rests.
☞ All three subjects at once: III in the bass, with I and II above it.
☞ All three again: III in the alto, I in the bass, II in the soprano.
☞ The last entries: all three subjects, III in the bass.

listenFor: a triple fugue; three new subjects, then all three together
